tests.label: Placebo treatment
tests.description: Randomly permute who got the discount. A real causal effect must collapse to ~0.
tests.note: placebo effect is 13% of the original

tests.label: Random common cause
tests.description: Add a random covariate as an extra confounder. The estimate should not move.

tests.label: Data subset
tests.description: Re-estimate on random 80% subsets. A robust effect is stable across samples.

tests.label: Bootstrap resampling
tests.description: Re-estimate on bootstrap resamples (with replacement) to check sampling variability.

tests.label: Unobserved confounder
tests.description: Simulate a hidden confounder of moderate strength. The sign of the effect should survive.
